title: Disk Scan
description: Scan the system disk and see space usage by real file path.
readOnlyDescription: The background scan reads names, sizes, and other metadata until complete. It never reads file contents or modifies, moves, or uploads files.
failed: The storage scan could not finish

scanErrors.targetUnavailable: The selected location cannot be read right now. Make sure it still exists and is accessible, then try again.

access.title: Allow access to the whole system disk
access.description: macOS protects Mail, Messages, other app data, and similar locations. Full Disk Access lets the space map be as complete as possible; CoreRobin still reads metadata such as names, sizes, and dates only.
access.waiting: System Settings is open. If CoreRobin is missing, click + below the list and select CoreRobin.app. Enable it, then return to start scanning automatically.
access.unknown: Access could not be confirmed. You can still open System Settings or run a limited scan.
access.bundleMissingTitle: This process cannot be added to the access list
access.bundleMissingDescription: macOS cannot authorize a development process here. Install CoreRobin.app and reopen it from Applications; a limited scan is still available.
access.privacy: macOS controls this permission and you can turn it off at any time. CoreRobin never reads file contents or changes files during a scan.

estimateBoundary: This is an estimate for caches and trash, not a recommendation to remove everything.

quick.title: Quick scan
quick.description: Precisely check common large and cleanable locations
quick.scope: Downloads, Desktop, Documents, media folders, Trash, and common app and developer caches. Use a complete scan for application support data, containers, and other hidden folders.

complete.title: Complete scan
complete.description: Walk the entire system disk sequentially; takes longer

coverage.title: Scan coverage
coverage.quickResult: Precisely checked {{count}} common locations and found {{size}}
coverage.quickLimit: Other disk areas have not been scanned; this result is not presented as a whole-disk total.

snapshot.retained: Indexed on this device; browsing never rescans folders

cached.title: Previous scan restored
cached.description: Keep exploring without waiting. Directory navigation reads the local index and does not access the filesystem.

expired.title: This result is over 24 hours old
expired.description: CoreRobin keeps the map available so you can continue exploring. Refresh it before acting on cleanup choices.

progress.paused: This computer is asleep; scanning will continue after wake
progress.stalledDescription: CoreRobin is skipping this unreadable location and continuing from saved progress. You do not need to restart the scan.
progress.finalizingDescription: The folders have been scanned. CoreRobin is now organizing the index and replacing the previous result; this can take a little longer for a large disk.
progress.recoveryFailed: The scan still did not continue after automatic recovery. Try again, or scan a smaller location.
progress.rootStalled: The system disk scan stopped making progress, so CoreRobin ended this attempt. Try again, or scan a specific folder.

results.moreDescription: Review common locations by purpose or inspect large files individually.

categories.title: What this space is commonly used for

map.title: Where the space went
map.description: Sector area represents allocated disk space. Related hues belong to one folder branch; gray sectors are files.
map.descriptionPath: Shown by real path across the system disk: each ring is the next directory level, and sector area represents allocated disk space.
map.descriptionCategory: The same scan is regrouped by common purpose. Categories are a supporting view, not the real directory hierarchy.

view.label: Browse as
view.loadFailed: Could not load the list. Try again.
view.empty: No matching items in this folder

map.aggregateHint: This is a summary group. Open it to review and select specific folders.
map.restrictedHint: The operating system did not grant read access; this item cannot be collected
map.noDeeperBreakdown: No deeper directory grouping is available at this level.
map.loadDeeperHint: Select this folder to open the next level from the local index.
map.otherContentHint: This group contains only files omitted from the current page or individual file details. Every child folder is indexed; use Show 50 more items to continue browsing directories.
map.loadFailed: Unable to read the directory index
map.directActionHint: Drag a sector or a folder from the list into the basket at the bottom
map.protectedSelectionHint: System paths and the home root are view-only; only specific items inside your home folder can enter the basket
map.trashRootProtected: The Trash folder itself is protected; enter it and select the specific contents you want to remove

basket.title: Cleanup basket
basket.protectedMessage: System files and important settings are protected and were not added
basket.empty: Drag a sector or a folder here to collect it before cleanup
basket.release: Release to add to the basket
basket.collectedHint: Already collected; remove it from the basket below or continue reviewing
basket.partial: Processed {{deletedCount}} items; {{failedCount}} could not be handled

deleteResult.cancelledNoDeletion: Cleanup stopped before any item completed
deleteResult.reclaimed: About {{size}} of physical allocation was processed
deleteResult.released: Filesystem available space increased by about {{size}}
deleteResult.pendingReclaim: {{processed}} was processed; available space has increased by {{size}} so far. The difference may remain in APFS snapshots, purgeable space, or delayed system reclaim.
deleteResult.trashSpace: Items are now in Trash; the corresponding space is normally released only after Trash is emptied

freshness.expired: This scan is old; a rescan is recommended
freshness.updating: Updating the scan; the previous map remains available
freshness.changed: This folder changed; sizes may be inaccurate

deleteDialog.title: Review the cleanup basket
deleteDialog.description: Move these items to Trash, or remove them from disk permanently.
deleteDialog.trashModeDescription: Keep a recovery path and restore the items later if needed.
deleteDialog.permanentModeDescription: Release the space immediately without using Trash.
deleteDialog.changedWarning: {{count}} items changed after they were added. Sizes and item counts are updated; recheck before continuing.
deleteDialog.deleteConfirmTitle: I understand these items will be permanently deleted
deleteDialog.deleteConfirmDescription: Files will not enter Trash. Downloads, settings, and personal data may not be reproducible.
deleteDialog.trashConfirmTitle: I confirm these items can move to Trash
deleteDialog.trashConfirmDescription: They leave their current paths immediately and remain recoverable until Trash is emptied.
deleteDialog.cancelHint: Completed items are not restored automatically. CoreRobin will stop after the current file operation.

errors.protected_cleanup_path: CoreRobin will not delete operating-system locations, credential stores, protected data-library roots, temporary folder roots, your home directory, or the Trash folder itself.
errors.cleanup_target_outside_home: For safety, CoreRobin only handles content inside your personal folder or approved temporary locations.
errors.cleanup_cross_filesystem: The selected directory enters another disk or mount point, so CoreRobin refused recursive deletion.
errors.cleanup_target_changed: A file changed after confirmation, so CoreRobin deleted nothing. Cancel and review it again.
errors.cleanup_confirmation_unavailable: This confirmation is no longer available. Cancel and reopen the review.
errors.cleanup_target_unavailable: Some content no longer exists or cannot be accessed. Rescan and try again.
errors.invalid_cleanup_selection: The cleanup basket selection is invalid. Choose the items again.
errors.overlapping_cleanup_targets: A folder and one of its children are both selected. Keep only one level.
errors.cleanup_target_conflicts_with_trash: The selection contains or is already in Trash and can only be deleted directly.
errors.cleanup_trash_unavailable: CoreRobin could not safely use the system Trash. Nothing was removed; try again later.

downloads.title: Downloads
downloads.description: May contain installers, documents, and files you still need.

trash.title: Trash
trash.description: Items are usually no longer recoverable after the trash is emptied.

app_cache.title: Application caches
app_cache.description: Apps may recreate or download this data again later.

developer_cache.title: Developer caches
developer_cache.description: Data that build tools and package managers can recreate.

hidden_data.title: Hidden user folders
hidden_data.description: Dot-prefixed app data and configuration. Review specific items before adding them to the cleanup basket.

fileInsights.title: Duplicate and long-unmodified files
fileInsights.description: Inspect common personal folders separately, filtering by size before content fingerprints are verified locally.
fileInsights.launcherDescription: Open a dedicated workspace for scan progress, duplicate groups, and large long-unmodified files.

phaseDescription.discovering: Reviewing names, sizes, and modification dates in common personal folders to narrow the content candidates.
phaseDescription.hashing: Reading same-sized candidates and calculating SHA-256 locally; content never leaves this computer.

fileInsights.loadingPrivacy: Hashes are calculated locally. File names, paths, and contents are not uploaded.
fileInsights.truncated: This scan reached its safety limit; completed results are shown.
fileInsights.noDuplicates: No duplicate content was found among checked candidates.
fileInsights.longUnmodified: Over 100 MB and unchanged for 180 days
fileInsights.noOldFiles: No matching large files were found.
fileInsights.boundary: Evidence and path actions only; nothing is deleted automatically. Long-unused is approximated by modification time, not last access time.
fileInsights.empty: Candidate contents are read and SHA-256 hashed locally only after you start the check; nothing is uploaded.
fileInsights.welcomeTitle: Surface identical content, not just matching file names
fileInsights.welcomeDescription: CoreRobin quickly filters same-sized files before verifying their content fingerprints, while separately organizing large long-unmodified files for your review.
fileInsights.completeDescription: Start with the duplicate groups offering the largest possible savings.

processing.selectionHint: Every selected group explicitly keeps one file; only the extra copies are processed.
processing.emptySelection: Select duplicate groups to process and confirm which file to keep in each group.
processing.dialogDescription: At least one file is kept in every group. Move extras to Trash, or permanently delete them after confirmation. File state and protected paths are rechecked first.
processing.refreshIncomplete: CoreRobin could not match every refreshed duplicate file by path.

largestFiles: Large files on the system disk
largeFileBoundary: Only files over 500 MB are listed; automatic deletion is not recommended
noLargeFiles: No files over 500 MB were found in accessible system-disk locations.
unreadable: {{count}} locations were protected or temporarily unreadable. Only those locations are excluded from the result.
fullDiskAccessHint: On macOS, grant CoreRobin Full Disk Access in System Settings → Privacy & Security, then scan again.
safetyBoundary: The scan has no time or item limit and never follows symbolic links. Only basket items that pass path checks and explicit confirmation are moved to Trash or deleted permanently.

targets.title: Choose what to scan
targets.readOnlyNotice: External volumes and folders are scanned read-only; file actions still use the existing reviewed cleanup basket.

growth.title: Space change since the last scan
growth.noGrowth: No growing directory was found in the compact comparison.

oldFileProcessing.selectionHint: Only the files you select are added to the reviewed cleanup basket.
oldFileProcessing.emptySelection: Select long-unmodified files that you have confirmed are no longer needed.
oldFileProcessing.dialogDescription: Review the selected files, then move them to Trash or permanently delete them after confirmation. Missing files are skipped.
oldFileProcessing.refreshIncomplete: CoreRobin could not match every refreshed long-unmodified file by path.

quickClean.title: Quick Cleanup
quickClean.description: Clear caches, logs, temporary files and Trash in one tap. Your documents and photos stay untouched.
quickClean.empty: Nothing to clean — your disk is tidy!
quickClean.skippedNote: {{count}} items were in use and safely skipped.
quickClean.noRiskNote: Only regenerable caches and discarded Trash content are removed — never your documents, photos or sign-in data.
quickClean.launcherDescription: No scan needed — clear caches, logs, temp files and Trash in one tap.
quickClean.guideDescription: Scan the whole disk, see space usage by real file path, then decide what to clean.
quickClean.analyzingHint: Measuring caches, logs, temp files and Trash…
